LINPACK provenance and licensing
===============================

Gonum v0.17.0, mat/cholesky.go, Cholesky.SymRankOne is based on
LINPACK dchud.f and dchdd.f:
https://www.netlib.org/linpack/dchud.f
https://www.netlib.org/linpack/dchdd.f

Original attribution in both routines:
c     linpack. this version dated 08/14/78 .
c     g.w. stewart, university of maryland, argonne national lab.

The LINPACK readme credits:
Developed by Jack Dongarra, Jim Bunch, Cleve Moler and Pete Stewart.
 1 Feb 84

Licensing evidence:
On 26 August 2013, Björn Esser's Fedora LINPACK package review quoted
this response from Jack Dongarra:

  LINPACK is licensed under the Modified 3 clause BSD license.
  Hope this helps,
  Jack Dongarra

https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=1000829#c13

On 31 August 2013, the same packager recorded that upstream had confirmed
the complete BSD-3-Clause text sent to them:
https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=1000829#c25

The evidence is a public packager's record of upstream correspondence.
The original complete email has not been recovered for this notice.

Standard BSD-3-Clause terms and disclaimer
----------------------------------------
The following standard text reproduces the specifically identified license
from SPDX license-list-data v3.27.0, commit
d46e94e2c78ceede1cfc63cfa0396472d2798d4c, text/BSD-3-Clause.txt.
It is a supplemental reproduction, not a recovered LINPACK license file
or a transcription of Dongarra's complete email. The template copyright
line is omitted; the original source attribution is retained above.
